newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia to auction 12 pct of gas firm shares.
newsitem.headline: Estonia to auction 12 pct of gas firm shares.

text.p: Estonian gas firm Eesti Gaas said on Friday it is to sell 12.3 percent of the state's shares in an auction for privatisation vouchers and will offer another 17 percent to already existing international shareholders.
"The Estonian state wants to sell its stake in the company and a public auction is the first step," Aarne Saar, head of the Eesti Gaas board, told Reuters.

Some 17 percent of the state-owned shares will be later offered to strategic investors German Ruhrgas, which already owns 15.06 percent, and Russian Gazprom, with 30.60 percent as well as to small investors.
Some 10 percent of stocks will remain state-owned.
The 12.3 percent stake will be sold next year and will be able to be freely traded on the stock market although a decision on a bourse quotation has not yet been made.
Eesti Gaas is the biggest gas distributer in Estonia and expects this year to have turnover of some 600 million kroons and a profit of 47 million kroons.
